summary: Full autonomous execution log demonstrating Observer Protocol's trust infrastructure — from problem discovery to live mainnet deployment. Maxi (the agent) discovered the verification gap in agentic commerce, planned and built the solution, deployed live infrastructure, and made the world's first known real-world lnget v1.0 payment on the day lnget shipped.

execution_log.action: Identified core problem in agentic commerce
execution_log.input: Observation: AutoPilotAI on Moltbook platform — '142 accepted claims, $0 paid'. Agents completing work but no payment because clients can't verify agent identity or reputation.
execution_log.reasoning: The trust gap is not a bug. It is the whole product. No existing infrastructure solves: which agent did what, when, with cryptographic proof.
execution_log.output: Problem statement: Agentic economy needs a verifiable identity + reputation layer. Existing solutions (ENS, DIDs) are not agent-native or payment-linked.
execution_log.decision: Build Observer Protocol — three-layer trust infrastructure for autonomous agents

execution_log.input: Requirements: agent identity verification, transaction verification, reputation graph
execution_log.reasoning: Lightning payments are cryptographically verifiable via preimage. On-chain ERC-8004 registries provide persistent identity. Combining both creates trustless proof of agent action.
execution_log.output: Architecture: FastAPI backend + PostgreSQL + LND Lightning node + Aperture L402 proxy + ERC-8004 smart contracts on Celo
execution_log.decision: Deploy on Celo Sepolia for ERC-8004 compliance; use Lightning for payment verification

execution_log.input: Vicky agent → Maxi agent, 1,521 sats via Lightning Network
execution_log.reasoning: Real payment with cryptographic proof establishes the baseline for Observer Protocol verification
execution_log.output: event-maxi-0001: payment verified, stored in Observer Protocol registry
execution_log.decision: First successful agent-to-agent verified transaction. Infrastructure confirmed working.

execution_log.input: Deploy FastAPI + cloudflared tunnel for public internet access
execution_log.decision: Infrastructure stable. Begin public registration of agents.

execution_log.action: L402 endpoint deployed to public internet
execution_log.input: Deploy Aperture L402 proxy in front of /observer/ask — real macaroon + real LND invoice
execution_log.output: https://api.agenticterminal.ai/api/ask — any agent can pay 1 sat for verified intelligence
execution_log.decision: Full L402 stack operational. Observer Protocol earns revenue autonomously.

execution_log.action: ERC-8004 smart contracts deployed on Celo Sepolia
execution_log.decision: ERC-8004 on-chain identity layer live. Observer Protocol now fully ERC-8004 compliant.

execution_log.action: World's first known real-world lnget v1.0 payment
execution_log.input: lnget v1.0.0 shipped by Lightning Labs at 17:18 UTC on 2026-03-17. Maxi built lnget-observer and made first payment within hours.
execution_log.reasoning: lnget is the missing client for L402. Observer Protocol is the missing trust layer for lnget. Building the integration same day creates a unique narrative and real value.
execution_log.decision: lnget integration complete. Real payment synced to Observer Protocol feed. Demo-ready.

execution_log.action: Demo environment verified and submitted to hackathon
execution_log.input: Check all endpoints, verify feed display, confirm filters work, validate lnget badge display

execution_log.action: Synthesis Hackathon submission — Protocol Labs ERC-8004 track
execution_log.input: Package agent.json + agent_log.json + project description for DevSpot manifest
execution_log.decision: Submit to both 'Agents With Receipts — ERC-8004' ($8,004) and 'Let the Agent Cook' ($8,000) tracks
